sloka: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भूतपूर्वं न किल्बिषम् ।तस्याः फलमुपाश्नीयामपापा मैथिली यदि ।। ७.९६.२१ ॥
transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā bhūtapūrvaṁ na kilbiṣam ।tasyāḥ phalamupāśnīyāmapāpā maithilī yadi ।। 7.96.21 ॥

translations.english: If Maithili is sinless, then may I enjoy the fruit of never having committed any sin by thought, word, or deed.
